name: Myla Alcera Quilingan
headline: Consulting Technical Director at Oracle NetSuite
about:
Consulting Technical Director specializing in NetSuite ERP and Netsuite Suite Projects Pro, with over 12 + years of experience leading implementations, technical support, and complex client engagements. NetSuite ERP Certified, with deep expertise across multiple industries and business models.

Known for building and strengthening executive-level client relationships, while driving strategic initiatives that increase adoption, expand solutions, and maximize ROI on NetSuite investments. Proven track record in translating business needs into scalable technical solutions and identifying growth opportunities that deliver measurable value.

Results-driven, goal-oriented, and passionate about continuous improvement, with a strong ability to lead through change and take on new challenges.
